messages.author: 7a5c2ea68524e713
messages.subject: Poster for UseR?
parts:
Dear all,

I was wondering whether GSoC-R could/should present a poster (I thought of one
shared poster for all projects) at the UseR! conference.

Please let me know what you think of that. If it meets agreement, I'd submit a
"dummy" abstract. Abstract deadline is April 1st, so as that's before the
student deadline, we obviously cannot say what the results be nor even which
projects are going to take place. However, the conference is at end of August,
so the projects are basically over by then and all results are known, and
red-hot results do obviously much more charme than presenting last year's GSoC
results when the next GSoC is already over.

Claudia
